shelf.title: Shelf
shelf.fromLinkHint: A Google Doc, or any direct file URL
shelf.linkHint: A Google Doc link comes in as .docx. The file must be readable without signing in.
shelf.linkSignIn: That link asked us to sign in. Share it as "anyone with the link", or download it and import the file.
shelf.kindTitle: What kind of book is this?

import.title: Import
import.noText: No text found in this file. If it's a scanned PDF, the pages are images — we can't read those.
import.previewEmpty: Nothing readable came out. If the pages are scans, they're images.

book.deleteConfirm: Delete this book? Its notes and highlights go with it.
book.title: Title
book.author: Author
book.summaryPlaceholder: What is this book about? A few sentences.
book.aiSummarizeWhat: Writes a few sentences from the chapter briefs where they exist, and from the opening where they don't. Yours is replaced, so copy it first if you want to keep it.
book.analyzeWhat: Reads all {{count}} chapters one at a time — each with the book so far as context — and writes their briefs, characters, places and scenes. Then writes the book's summary from what they said. Chapters already read are free to repeat.
book.analyzeQueued: {{count}} chapters queued. Tap the bar at the bottom to watch it.

reader.hint: Tap any sentence to highlight, note or share it.
reader.notePlaceholder: What do you want to remember about this?
reader.shareCardHint: A themed page in your reading colors.

settings.title: Settings
settings.aiHint: Used by chapter detection and analysis. Keys never leave this device, including in backups.
settings.cloudHint: Storage you own. Off by default.
settings.backupHint: Survives a bad import or a corrupt database — not a lost phone. Copy the file off to keep it safe.
settings.aiGetOne: Don't have a {{vendor}} key? Get one →
settings.aiBilling: Requests are billed to your own {{vendor}} account.
settings.aiStrategyHint: Order is the fallback order. Sequential stays on the first key until it errors; round robin spreads every call.
settings.privateCloudHint: Storage you own. Off by default.

entity.name: Name
entity.summaryPlaceholder: Who are they, in a line or two?
entity.polishWhat: Turns {{count}} chapter notes about this character into a profile: summary, role, appearance, voice and arc. The per-chapter notes stay as they are underneath, so you can run it again or check what it drew on.
entity.barScale: Each bar covers {{count}} chapters — tap one
entity.relationSearch: Search the cast, or type a new name
entity.relationEmpty: Nobody else in this book yet.

notes.empty: Highlights and notes you make while reading show up here.

structure.title: Structure
structure.unsureCount: {{count}} chapters the detector wasn't sure about.
structure.redetectConfirm: Re-run detection? Chapters you renamed keep their names.
structure.redetectHint: Your renames and splits survive a re-run; everything else is recomputed.
structure.noSplitPoints: This chapter is a single paragraph — there's nowhere to split it.
structure.aiDetectWhat: Sends only the short lines that could be headings — never the manuscript — and asks which are chapters. Your renames are kept.
structure.aiFoundNothing: No chapters found. Nothing was changed.
structure.deleteConfirm: Its text joins the neighbouring chapter. Nothing is removed from the manuscript.
structure.aiScenes: Suggest scene breaks in every chapter
structure.aiScenesWhat: Sends the first line of each paragraph — never the prose — and asks where the time, place or viewpoint changes. Chapters you've already marked are overwritten.
structure.aiBriefsWhat: One or two sentences per chapter, written with the book's summary and the chapters just before it as context. Chapters you've already briefed are skipped.
structure.aiChapterBrief: Write this chapter's brief with AI
structure.aiOneWhat: Reads this one chapter with the book's summary, the chapters just before it, and everyone already known as context. Writes its brief, its characters and its places.
structure.aiOneBriefWhat: One or two sentences on what happens, written with the chapters just before it as context.

backup.title: Backup
backup.icloudOff: iCloud Drive is off on this device
backup.icloudDirections: Settings → your name → iCloud → iCloud Drive → turn on
backup.icloudUnsigned: This build of the app isn't signed for iCloud.
backup.waiting: {{count}} books are waiting for their file
backup.waitingDetail: Import the same file again and its notes, profiles and chapters come back with it.
backup.restoredWaiting: {{count}} books need their file imported again.
backup.fileHint: One .zip file holds your books, structure, notes and profiles — open it anywhere. It never contains an AI key.
backup.restoreConfirm: Restoring adds books; it never overwrites what's already here.
backup.duplicates: Already on your shelf, restored as copies: {{list}}
backup.unplaceable_no-text: {{title}} had no text and was skipped.
backup.notABundle: That isn't a Novel Man backup.
backup.tooNew: This backup was made by a newer version (v{{version}}). Update the app first.

ai.canceled: Stopped. What had already finished was kept.
ai.noKey: No AI key configured. Add one in Settings first.
ai.estimateHint: An estimate, not a quote. Billed to your own account. Results are cached, so a repeat run is free.
ai.estimateNoKey: add an AI key to see the cost

cast.hint: Each pass reads the book once and caches what it learns, so running it again costs nothing for the parts that haven't changed.
cast.what_extract: Reads the opening of every chapter and lists who appears, what they look like and how they speak. Profiles you wrote yourself are left alone.
cast.what_relations: Asks how the characters who share chapters are connected. Sends profiles, not the manuscript.
cast.what_continuity: Compares what different chapters said about the same person and flags what disagrees. Flags are suggestions to review, never edits.
cast.extracted: {{characters}} character entries across the book. {{failed}} chapters failed.
cast.flagged: {{count}} things to look at. {{failed}} characters failed.
cast.graphHint: Tap a character to isolate them. Hold to open their profile. Drag to move the graph.
cast.clearConfirm: Removes generated profiles, appearances, relationships and flags. Profiles you wrote yourself stay.
cast.what_deep: One pass per chapter, given the book's summary, the chapters just before it, and everyone already known — so names stay consistent and each chapter knows what it continues from. Writes the chapter's brief, its cast and its places.

translate.empty: Add a language to translate this book into. Nothing is sent anywhere until you run it.
translate.glossaryHint: Names and terms in the glossary are obeyed exactly. Fill it in before a long run — changing one afterwards re-runs only the sentences that use it.
translate.title: Translate into {{language}}
translate.what: Translates sentence by sentence, keeping your glossary and your past corrections. Only untranslated and stale sentences are sent.
translate.promoteHint: A term is obeyed in every chapter, and the sentences already using it are marked for re-running.
translate.termAffects: {{count}} translated sentences use it and are now marked for re-running.
translate.seeded: {{count}} names added. Fill in their translations.
translate.lockHint: A locked term is one you have decided. Tap the lock to mark it settled.
translate.candidatesHint: Names and repeated proper nouns that aren't in the glossary yet. Tap one to start adding it.
translate.removeConfirm: Delete the {{language}} translation, including your edits?

cloud.title: Cloud backup
cloud.hint: iCloud keeps what you made — notes, characters, progress, settings — and not the books. A bucket you own keeps everything, manuscripts included, and nothing goes up until you ask.
cloud.name: Name
cloud.pasteHint: Paste a console block, an .env chunk or a CSV row and the fields fill themselves in.
cloud.saveHint: Saving makes a real request. A bucket that can't be listed isn't saved.
cloud.frequencyHint: Manual by default. Automatic syncs run when you open the app, never in the background.
cloud.getHint: Getting a bundle restores it the same way a file does — it adds, it never overwrites.
cloud.removeConfirm: Removes the connection and its key from this device. Nothing in the bucket is touched.

script.hint: One pass per scene, so the split you made in the structure editor is the split the screenplay gets.
script.what: Turns each scene into slug lines, action and dialogue. Interior thoughts become what a camera could see, which is a real rewrite — read it before you use it.
script.clearConfirm: Deletes the converted screenplay. The novel is untouched.

work.title: Work
work.hint: Work carries on while you read, and picks up where it left off if you close the app. Finished chapters are kept even if a run is stopped.
work.queued: Queued {{count}} chapters. Watch it on the shelf.

chapter.title: Chapter
chapter.noScenes: No scenes yet — mark one, or let an analysis read for them.
chapter.hint: Names here open that profile. Analyzing the chapter fills the scenes, the cast and the places.

keyLog.title: AI key
keyLog.empty: Nothing sent with this key yet.
keyLog.hint: Only requests that actually went out are here — a cached answer costs nothing and is not sent. The last 300 are kept, and the key itself is never stored in this log.
keyLog.clearConfirm: Delete the request history for this key?
keyLog.modelCustomHint: Type an id the list is missing and press done. Priced as an estimate.
keyLog.modelHint: This key runs on the model picked here. A cheaper model is fine for a first sweep; a stronger one reads scenes and characters out of a chapter far more reliably.

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.emptyHint: Scenes come from analyzing a chapter, or from marking a break yourself in the chapter list. Nothing is guessed at import.
scenes.noSummary: No summary for this one yet.

place.name: Name
place.summaryPlaceholder: A line or two about this place.
place.noMentions: Not recorded in any chapter yet.
place.hint: A place is filled in by analyzing the chapters it appears in. Everything here can be edited or added by hand.
place.polishWhat: Turns {{count}} chapter notes about this place into a profile: what it is, what it is like, and what happens there. The per-chapter notes stay as they are underneath, so you can run it again or check what it drew on.

scene.title: Scene
scene.hint: Who is in a scene is counted from the scene's own words, so a name only mentioned elsewhere in the chapter does not appear here.

kind.novelHint: Fiction — cast, scenes, screenplay and illustrations
kind.scriptureHint: Real people and places, read as record — no scenes or screenplay
kind.nonfictionHint: Real people and places, read as record — no scenes or screenplay
kind.tutorialHint: Instructions — structure, terms and notes, no cast
kind.textbookHint: Course material — structure, terms and notes, no cast
